name: Salesforce
description: Salesforce is a cloud-based CRM platform that centralizes customer data across sales, service, marketing, and IT so teams share one view of the customer, with AI layered in for automation and assistance.
best_for: Salesforce markets itself for companies of any size wanting a single, AI-enabled platform unifying sales, service, marketing, and IT — from small businesses up through large enterprises.
features: AI agents for autonomous task handling

tiers.name: Free Suite
tiers.notes: 2 user licenses included. No contract or credit card required. Lead/opportunity/case management, assistive AI.

tiers.name: Starter Suite
tiers.notes: Starting price per user/month, billed monthly or annually. Transaction fees apply. Unlimited users, built-in sales flows.

tiers.name: Pro Suite
tiers.notes: Starting price per user/month, billed annually -- a signed contract is required for this tier. Transaction fees apply. Advanced automation, sales quoting/forecasting.

cons: Pro Suite and above require a signed annual contract -- unlike Starter Suite, you can't pay month-to-month once you need Pro-tier features.
Transaction fees apply on paid tiers on top of the per-user subscription price, per the vendor's own pricing page.
This page covers Salesforce's small-business CRM Suite pricing; the vendor's larger Enterprise/Unlimited/Agentforce editions for bigger organizations are priced and sold separately.

alternatives.name: HubSpot
alternatives.description: A CRM platform with a free tier covering contact, deal, and pipeline management alongside marketing and service tools.
alternatives.best_for: Startups and small businesses that want to start free and scale up

alternatives.name: Pipedrive
alternatives.description: A sales-focused CRM built around a visual pipeline for tracking leads and deals.
alternatives.best_for: Small to mid-sized sales teams wanting a simpler, sales-first tool

alternatives.name: Zoho CRM
alternatives.description: A cloud-based sales platform using the Zia AI assistant to manage leads, deals, and customer relationships with omnichannel engagement and no-code workflow automation.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses already using or considering the wider Zoho suite who want CRM bundled with dozens of adjacent apps
